Bill.BriefDescription: Allowing sales of growlers of cider.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to allowing sales of growlers of cider; and addinga new section to chapter 66.28 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 66.28 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Licensees holding either a license that permits or a licensewith an endorsement that permits the sale of beer to a purchaser in acontainer supplied by the licensee or a sanitary container brought tothe premises by the purchaser and filled at the tap at the time of salemay similarly sell cider to a purchaser in such a container. (2) For purposes of this section, "cider" has the same meaning asin RCW 66.24.210(6).
